propositions: jira_dc_pat fixture is function-scoped and mints a new Personal Access Token per test, exhausting Jira DC's 10-token-per-user limit as test count grows
errors surface at setup of unrelated test modules because token exhaustion is session-wide, making the root cause difficult to diagnose
changing jira_dc_pat to session scope reduces PAT consumption from O(tests) to O(1) since all tests need only a single valid credential
leftover tokens from crashed runs prevent subsequent runs from acquiring new tokens and must be swept at session start
sweep helper must safely degrade when token list endpoint is unavailable or returns non-list responses, and failed token deletes must not abort the session
sweep must only delete tokens prefixed with rebar-j5-harness- to avoid deleting unrelated user tokens
